popup_failureServerError.message: Nexus is not responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.
popup_failureServerError.description: Error line shown when the Nexus servers answer with a fault of their own.

popup_failureBadRequest.message: Nexus rejected the request as malformed. Check the game and version, then try again.
popup_failureBadRequest.description: Error line shown when Nexus rejects the request as badly formed.

popup_failureNotConfigured.message: Nothing is configured to check yet. Pick a game and a start version above.
popup_failureNotConfigured.description: Error line shown when a compatibility check is asked for before a game and a start version have been chosen.

popup_failureUnsupportedGame.message: No game version has been derived for this game yet, so there is nothing to compare a mod against. Every game is supported; this one has no public version data the assistant could find. Type the version you play to check anyway.
popup_failureUnsupportedGame.description: Error line shown when no public source names any version number for the selected game. It is careful to say the game is not unsupported, only undocumented.

popup_failureOffline.message: No connection to Nexus. Check your network, then try again.
popup_failureOffline.description: Error line shown when the computer appears to have no working network connection.

popup_failureHostPermissionMissing.message: The extension is not allowed to reach nexusmods.com. Your network is fine: the site access permission was declined or revoked. Grant it again in your browser's extension settings (Firefox: about:addons, then this extension, then Permissions).
popup_failureHostPermissionMissing.description: Error line shown when the browser blocks the extension from reaching nexusmods.com because the site access permission was refused. "about:addons" is a Firefox address and stays as it is; "Permissions" is the name of a tab in Firefox's own interface.

popup_failureTimeout.message: Nexus took too long to answer. Try again.
popup_failureTimeout.description: Error line shown when a request to Nexus, or to the extension's own background, ran out of time.

popup_failureDisabled.message: The assistant is switched off. Turn it back on with the switch at the top right.
popup_failureDisabled.description: Error line shown when something is asked of the extension while its main on/off switch is off.

popup_failureNoBackground.message: The extension background did not respond. Reopen this popup, or reload the extension.
popup_failureNoBackground.description: Error line shown when the extension's own background worker cannot be reached.

popup_failureCanceled.message: That request was canceled before it finished.
popup_failureCanceled.description: Error line shown when a request was abandoned before it completed.

popup_failureBackgroundError.message: The extension background could not complete that request.
popup_failureBackgroundError.description: Error line shown when the extension's background worker answered but reported a fault.

popup_failureContextInvalid.message: The extension was updated. Reload any open Nexus tabs.
popup_failureContextInvalid.description: Error line shown when the extension was reloaded or updated while pages from the old version were still open.

popup_unexpectedFailure.description: Error line used when a fault carries no recognized reason, so only its raw text can be shown.

popup_unexpectedFailureNoDetail.message: Unexpected failure, with no detail reported.
popup_unexpectedFailureNoDetail.description: Error line used when a fault carries neither a recognized reason nor any text to quote.

popup_requestFailed.description: Fallback wording for a failed request that the extension background reported without a message of its own.

popup_settingsReadFailed.message: The popup could not read your settings: $DETAIL$
popup_settingsReadFailed.description: Error line in the first card when the popup could not load the stored settings as it opened.

detail.example: Nexus took too long to answer. Try again.

popup_settingsUpdateFailed.description: Error line shown when the popup could not upgrade settings left by an earlier version of the extension.

popup_storageFull.message: Storage is full, so that setting was not saved. Use "Clear cached Nexus data" below, then try again.
popup_storageFull.description: Error line shown when a setting could not be saved because the browser's storage for this extension is full. The quoted phrase is the button labeled by popup_clearCache: translate both the same way.

popup_settingSaveFailed.description: Error line shown when a setting could not be saved for any reason other than full storage.

popup_noKeyCatalogNote.message: Without an API key you can target the game in your open Nexus tab, but the full Nexus catalog is not searchable and compatibility badges cannot be fetched.
popup_noKeyCatalogNote.description: Note under the game search box while no API key is stored, saying what still works without one.

popup_pasteReplacementKey.message: Paste the replacement key, then press Save.
popup_pasteReplacementKey.description: Status line in the Connection card after the user presses Replace key. "Save" is the button labeled by popup_save: use the same wording.

popup_pasteKeyFirst.message: Paste a key first. You can generate one with "Need a key?".
popup_pasteKeyFirst.description: Error line shown when Save is pressed with the API key box empty. The quoted phrase is the button labeled by popup_needKey: translate both the same way.

popup_keySaved.description: Status line confirming that the pasted API key was stored.

popup_keyUpdated.description: Status line shown when the stored API key changed elsewhere, in another popup window or through single sign-on, while this popup was open.

popup_disconnecting.description: Status line shown while the stored API key and the cached Nexus data are being removed.

popup_keyClearFailed.description: Error line shown when removing the stored API key failed.

popup_keyRemoved.message: Key removed. Your game and version target were kept.
popup_keyRemoved.description: Status line confirming that the API key and the cached Nexus data were removed cleanly.

popup_keyRemovedWithLeftovers.message: Key removed, and your game and version target were kept. However $ISSUES$: use "Clear cached Nexus data" below.
popup_keyRemovedWithLeftovers.description: Status line shown when the API key was removed but some cached data could not be. The placeholder is one or two of popup_leftBehindBackground and popup_leftBehindSteamCache, joined by popup_leftBehindSeparator, so it reads as a clause in the middle of this sentence. The quoted phrase is the button labeled by popup_clearCache: translate both the same way.

issues.example: the background did not answer, so cached Nexus responses are still on disk

popup_leftBehindBackground.message: the background did not answer, so cached Nexus responses are still on disk
popup_leftBehindBackground.description: One reason cached data survived a disconnect. It is inserted into the middle of popup_keyRemovedWithLeftovers, after the word "However", so it starts in lower case and carries no final period.

popup_leftBehindSteamCache.message: the Steam version cache could not be read, so it is still on disk
popup_leftBehindSteamCache.description: One reason cached data survived a disconnect. It is inserted into the middle of popup_keyRemovedWithLeftovers, after the word "However", so it starts in lower case and carries no final period. Steam is the name of a game store and stays as it is.

popup_leftBehindSeparator.description: Joins the two reasons in popup_keyRemovedWithLeftovers when both apply. Keep the leading comma and the surrounding spaces that the sentence needs in your language.

popup_noReadableVersion.message: None of the versions derived for this game could be read as a version number, so none was filled in. Type the game version you play.
popup_noReadableVersion.description: Status line shown when every version the extension found was text it cannot compare, such as a branch name, so the start version box was left empty.

popup_startVersionFilled.message: Start version filled in as $VERSION$, the newest build found for this game. Change it if you play an older one.
popup_startVersionFilled.description: Status line announcing that the extension filled the start version box by itself, because the user did not type that value.

popup_invertedRange.message: The end version $END$ is earlier than the start version $START$, so no mod could ever match. That range was not saved and the target you had is unchanged.
popup_invertedRange.description: Error line shown when the end of the version range is older than its start.

popup_chooseGameFirstForVersion.message: Choose a game first: a version on its own has nothing to compare against.
popup_chooseGameFirstForVersion.description: Status line shown when a version is entered before any game has been selected.

popup_chooseGameFirstForHarvest.message: Choose a game first, then versions can be derived for it.
popup_chooseGameFirstForHarvest.description: Error line shown when Refresh versions is pressed before any game has been selected.

popup_chooseGameBeforeContinuing.description: Error line shown when the main Open compatible mods button is pressed with no game selected.

popup_openTabIsGame.description: Sentence in the suggestion row at the top of the first card, naming the game of the Nexus page the user has open in a browser tab.

popup_savedTabMismatch.message: Saved. Your open Nexus tab is $GAME$, so this target does not apply to it.
popup_savedTabMismatch.description: Status line confirming the target was saved while warning that the Nexus page the user has open is for a different game.

popup_saved.description: Status line confirming that the chosen game and version range were stored.

popup_gameListNeedsKey.message: The game list needs an API key. Use the button above to target the game in your open tab.
popup_gameListNeedsKey.description: Status line shown when the game search finds nothing because no API key is stored, so the catalog was never downloaded.

popup_derivingVersions.description: Note inside the empty versions list while the search of public sources is still running.

popup_versionSearchIncomplete.message: The version search could not complete, so nothing here is a finding.
popup_versionSearchIncomplete.description: Note inside the empty versions list when the search failed, making clear that the empty list proves nothing.

popup_noVersionsFound.message: No public source names a version for this game. This list is empty because the data does not exist, not because the game is unsupported.
popup_noVersionsFound.description: Note inside the empty versions list when the search finished and found nothing.

popup_searching.description: Status line under the versions list while a first search of public sources is running.

popup_searchingAgain.description: Status line under the versions list while a search started by the Refresh versions button is running.

popup_versionSearchFailure.description: Status line under the versions list reporting why the search for game versions failed.

detail.example: Nexus took too long to answer. Try again.

popup_derivedOneVersion.description: Summary under the versions list when exactly one version was found and no source names were reported. COUNT is always 1 here.

popup_derivedManyVersions.description: Summary under the versions list when a number of versions other than one was found and no source names were reported.

popup_derivedOneVersionOneSource.description: Summary under the versions list when one version was found from one source. Both numbers are always 1 here.

popup_derivedOneVersionManySources.description: Summary under the versions list when one version was found from a number of sources other than one. COUNT is always 1 here.

popup_derivedManyVersionsOneSource.description: Summary under the versions list when several versions were found from one source. SOURCES is always 1 here.

popup_derivedManyVersionsManySources.description: Summary under the versions list when several versions were found from several sources.

popup_noVersionsSummary.message: No public source names a version for this game, so nothing was filled in. Type the version you play if you know it; leaving it empty is also fine.
popup_noVersionsSummary.description: Summary under the versions list when the search finished and found no version at all.

popup_oneRequestThisRefresh.description: Sentence appended to the version search summary, saying how many network requests the search cost. COUNT is always 1 here.

popup_requestsThisRefresh.description: Sentence appended to the version search summary, saying how many network requests the search cost, for any count other than one.

popup_storeNotBound.message: The store listing for this game could not be identified with confidence, so store sources were skipped rather than risk another game's numbers.
popup_storeNotBound.description: Sentence appended to the version search summary when the extension could not be sure which store page belongs to the selected game, and so ignored the store.

popup_downloadModeVortexSaved.message: Downloads are handed to your mod manager as nxm:// links, here and on any open Nexus tab.
popup_downloadModeVortexSaved.description: Status line confirming the download mode was switched to Vortex. "nxm://" is a link protocol name and stays as it is.

popup_downloadModeManualSaved.message: Downloads are saved by the browser, here and on any open Nexus tab.
popup_downloadModeManualSaved.description: Status line confirming the download mode was switched back to the browser's own downloads.

popup_verboseLoggingOn.message: Verbose logging on from the next background worker start.
popup_verboseLoggingOn.description: Status line in the Advanced card confirming verbose logging was switched on, and saying it applies from the next time the background worker starts.

popup_verboseLoggingOff.message: Verbose logging off from the next background worker start.
popup_verboseLoggingOff.description: Status line in the Advanced card confirming verbose logging was switched off, and saying it applies from the next time the background worker starts.

popup_openWithoutVersionTarget.description: Wording the main button takes on after it warns that no start version is set. Pressing it again opens the listing regardless.

popup_noStartVersionWarning.message: No start version is set, so badges will report that there is nothing to compare against instead of judging a mod. Filtering and downloads still work. Press again to open the listing anyway.
popup_noStartVersionWarning.description: Warning shown the first time the main button is pressed with no start version, explaining what is lost before the listing opens.

popup_clearing.description: Status line in the Advanced card while the cached Nexus data is being deleted.

popup_clearCacheBothFailed.message: The extension background did not answer and the Steam version cache could not be read, so neither could be cleared. The stored game list was cleared.
popup_clearCacheBothFailed.description: Error line reporting that clearing the cache reached neither of its two stores. Steam is the name of a game store and stays as it is.

popup_clearCacheBackgroundFailed.message: The extension background did not answer, so the mod response cache could not be cleared. The stored game list and Steam version cache were cleared.
popup_clearCacheBackgroundFailed.description: Error line reporting that clearing the cache could not reach the extension's background, so only part of the cache was deleted.

popup_clearCacheSteamFailed.message: Cleared $COUNT$ cached entries, $KB$ KB freed. The Steam version cache could not be read, so it may still be on disk.
popup_clearCacheSteamFailed.description: Status line reporting how much cache was cleared while warning that the Steam part could not be read. KB is the kilobyte unit.

popup_clearCacheDone.description: Status line reporting how many cached entries were deleted and how much space that freed. KB is the kilobyte unit.

popup_clearCacheNothing.message: No cached entries were reported, so nothing was freed.
popup_clearCacheNothing.description: Status line shown when clearing the cache succeeded but there was nothing stored to delete.

popup_noGameListCached.description: Status line in the Advanced card when an API key is stored but the Nexus game catalog has never been downloaded.

popup_gameListCached.description: Status line in the Advanced card saying how long ago the Nexus game catalog was downloaded. The placeholder is one of the popup_timeAgo strings, such as "3 hours ago" or "just now".

popup_timeAgoJustNow.description: Fills the placeholder in popup_gameListCached when the game list was downloaded less than a minute ago, so it reads "Game list cached just now."

popup_timeAgoMinute.description: Fills the placeholder in popup_gameListCached. COUNT is always 1 here.

popup_timeAgoMinutes.description: Fills the placeholder in popup_gameListCached, for any number of minutes other than one.

popup_timeAgoHour.description: Fills the placeholder in popup_gameListCached. COUNT is always 1 here.

popup_timeAgoHours.description: Fills the placeholder in popup_gameListCached, for any number of hours other than one.

popup_timeAgoDay.description: Fills the placeholder in popup_gameListCached. COUNT is always 1 here.

popup_timeAgoDays.description: Fills the placeholder in popup_gameListCached, for any number of days other than one.

popup_loadedTitles.description: Status line in the first card confirming how many game titles were downloaded from the Nexus catalog.

popup_gameListFailure.description: Status line in the first card reporting why the Nexus game catalog could not be downloaded.

detail.example: Nexus rejected your API key. Replace it under Connection.

popup_unexpectedGameList.message: The background returned an unexpected game list.
popup_unexpectedGameList.description: Reason reported in the first card when the extension's background answered with something that is not a game list.

popup_loadedTitlesOne.description: Status line after the game list is fetched, when exactly one title came back. Chrome's catalog has no plural rule, so the singular is a separate key from popup_loadedTitles.

popup_clearCacheDoneOne.description: Status line after clearing the cache, when exactly one entry was removed. KB is the kilobyte unit and stays as it is. Singular counterpart of popup_clearCacheDone.

popup_clearCacheSteamFailedOne.message: Cleared 1 cached entry, $KB$ KB freed. The Steam version cache could not be read, so it may still be on disk.
popup_clearCacheSteamFailedOne.description: Status line after clearing the cache when exactly one entry was removed and the Steam cache could not be read. Singular counterpart of popup_clearCacheSteamFailed.
